findings.title: Refund policy ignores the stated 24-hour refund policy
findings.why: task-001 says cancellations will follow a '24-hour refund policy'. cancel() instead refunds in full at any time before the start, even one second before, and refunds nothing from the start on. The task-005 doc admits this is an unconfirmed assumption, so customers cancelling within 24h of the start would get a different refund than the project's stated policy.

findings.title: Plan documents are empty scaffolds marked active
findings.why: The four plan files (1-2 to 1-5) keep only the placeholder comment, with no plan content. Their instructions say to replace the placeholder comments. Task 001 has no plan file at all.
